def equation(gate_voltage_abs: np.ndarray, drain_voltage_abs: np.ndarray, parameters: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Modelo empírico bivariado para log10(|ID|/A)."""
    """Improved version of `equation_v0` with saturation voltage consideration."""
    
    V_gsat = np.where(gate_voltage_abs > Vs[0], Vs[0], gate_voltage_abs)
    V_dsat = np.where(drain_voltage_abs > Vs[1], Vs[1], drain_voltage_abs)
    
    return parameters[0] + parameters[1] * V_gsat + parameters[2] * V_dsat
